query:
MATCH p = TRAIL (s:player {id: $seed})-[:follow]->{1,3}(:player)
RETURN ALL transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) AS node_ids;
notes: Uses documented TRAIL mode and 1-to-3-hop outgoing follow quantifier. transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) preserves node order; RETURN ALL retains parallel-edge path multiplicity. Checked against current skill references only; no database execution.
